title: Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
body:
Nusrat E Mazloom Ko Aajao Khudara
karb Ke Aalam Me Hame Shah Ne Pukara
matame Shabbir Hee Maqsad Hai Hamara
<<MINI>>
yaa Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
01. Aise Uthe Maatame Sarwar Ki Sadaye
dene Lage Fatima Zahra Bhi Duaye
karbobala Jaaye Ye Aawaz Madina
<<MINI>>
yaa Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
02. Saare Azadaro Ko Zahra Ki Dua Hai
rutba Ye Ghamkhaaro Ko Khismat Se Mila Hai
rok Nahi Sakta Hame Gham Se Zamana
<<MINI>>
yaa Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
03. Ghazi Alamdar Ki Hamsabko Qasam Hai
parcham E Abbas Ki Hamsabko Qasam Hai
haath Kate Maatam E Sarwar Ye Ruke Na
<<MINI>>
yaa Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
04. Baba Rachai Gai Kya Bhai Ki Shaadi
kaise Bhala Aapko Mai Yaad Na Aai
door Madine Me Hai Beemar Ye Sughra
<<MINI>>
yaa Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
05. Karbobala Me Jo Azaadar Ye Hote
laash Pe Asghar Ki Kabhi Rone Nahi Dete
dete Har Ek Gaam Pe Maula Ko Dilasa
<<MINI>>
yaa Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
06. Gham Me Tere Fatima Sar Peet Rahi Hai
pyaase Gale Per Tere Shamsheer Chali Hai
qatl Hua Pyaas Me Ek Boond Na Paaya
<<MINI>>
yaa Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
07. Baad E Pidar Khaak Hua Beti Ka Jeena
neend Mujhe Aati Nahi Baap Ka Seena
roti Rahi Kehti Rahi Baali Sakina
<<MINI>>
yaa Hussain Ya Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
08. Rote Rahe Shaah Pe Rote Hee Rahenge
maut Bhi Aajaye To Maatam Ye Karenge
nusrat E Mazloom Hai Dawar Ye Ruke Na
